svg.title: SafeFlipLab pipeline overview (V01 and V02)
svg.desc: Text-only diagram of the V01 and V02 pipelines: frozen config to phase driver, four-condition quartets, ledger and report; shared safety gates and publication verification at the bottom.
svg.text: SafeFlipLab — pipeline overview
v1.0 research package (frozen) + v1.1 engineering shell · exploratory, INCONCLUSIVE · no real-road safety claim
V01 — safefliplab/ (binary endpoint)
configs/dev_v01.json (smoke 24 / pilot 240) · frozen formal_v01.json (NO-GO)
experiments.PhaseDriver
seeds → generator (anchors) → quartet conditions 00 / 10 / 01 / 11
runner → adapter
ScenarioAdapter (real) · FakeAdapter (tests/offline demo, zero episodes)
EpisodeLedger — launch before run, then outcome
billed attempts · budget scope · sidecar lock · raw_path is the source of truth
report.py → reports/ (md, json, csv, figures) · 58/58 byte-idempotent
V01 finding: 264/264 zero collisions → binary endpoint has zero variance.
That structural result motivated V02 (continuous min-forward-TTC endpoint).
V02 — v02/v02lab/ (continuous endpoint)
v02/configs/v02_frozen_v1.json (smoke 24 / pilot 240; SHA-256 frozen)
anchors.py → conditions.py → quartet.py
18 deterministic anchors · shared in-anchor perturbation · 00/10/01/11
phases.py → runner.py → adapter_real.py
RealAdapterV02 (HighwayEnv) · FakeAdapterV02 (tests/offline demo)
ledger21.py — 21-column ledger
discovery vs audit streams · PAIR_MISSING handling · D42/D44 disclosed
stats_anchor.py (anchor-level bootstrap) → report.py → v02/reports/
V02 result: all four primary intervals cross 0; M1/M2 disagree on Δgap;
binary endpoint is nearly information-free (2 events / 54 quartets).
Shared safety gates and engineering shell
formal: both --confirm and --max-episodes 12800 required → refusal raised BEFORE any runs/ file is created (EXIT 2)
budget caps: smoke ≤ 24, pilot ≤ 240; ledger rejects over-cap launches; no free retries; _require_formal_go guards non-CLI callers
doctor: strictly read-only (reports “no ledger in this checkout” instead of creating one)
Verification (offline, zero simulator episodes)
tests: V01 234 OK (skipped=1) · V02 143 OK — FakeAdapter / synthetic data only; no runs/ residue
PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.csv: 200 files / 3,111,181 bytes, byte-exact at v1.0 (commit baee8be)
verify_publication.py: v1.0 byte-exact + v1.1 engineering scope (explicit whitelists; no wildcards)
Sources: README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, TESTING.md, PUBLICATION_SCOPE.md. Diagram is text-only; no external assets.
